title: BlockPy Desktop E2E — workspace UI inspection

steps.title: App shell rendered
steps.caption: Electron window loads the React app shell.

steps.title: Visual Blocks workspace
steps.caption: The Blockly workspace is injected and visible.

steps.title: Files tab opens the workspace tree
steps.caption: Clicking Files shows the VS Code-style file tree.

steps.title: Starter main.py is present
steps.caption: The seeded main.py appears in the tree.

steps.title: Sample image is present
steps.caption: sample.jpg (for cv2.imread) is in the workspace root.

steps.title: Open main.py into the editor
steps.caption: Clicking the file opens it; the active-file chip updates.

steps.title: Editor loaded the file content
steps.caption: The Python editor holds the opened file's text.

steps.title: New Folder input appears
steps.caption: The New Folder button reveals an inline name input.

steps.title: Create a folder
steps.caption: Typing a name and Add creates the folder in the tree.

steps.title: Run button (real Python)
steps.caption: The Run button drives the real local-Python backend.

steps.title: Save button
steps.caption: Save writes the open file back to the workspace.

steps.title: Python Source editor tab
steps.caption: The right pane exposes the Python source editor.

steps.title: AST Parser Tree tab
steps.caption: The AST tree tab is available.

steps.title: Terminal tab shows the console
steps.caption: The Terminal tab renders the console/logs panel.

steps.title: AI / Library tab
steps.caption: The AI tab exposes the library blockify/pip controls.

steps.title: Sprite stage is gone
steps.caption: The old turtle/sprite stage was removed (no canvas, no Stage tab).
